abstract: OBJECTIVE: The goal of this work was to study the expression of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) and c-erbB-3 and c-erbB-4 oncogenes in gestational trophoblastic diseases and normal first-trimester placenta. STUDY DESIGN: Paraffin sections of 16 cases of partial mole, 25 cases of complete mole, 10 cases of gestational choriocarcinoma, and 11 cases of therapeutic abortion were studied immunohistochemically for EGFR, c-erbB-3, and c-erbB-4 proteins. The presence of EGFR mRNA was studied using in situ hybridization. RESULTS: Staining for EGFR was detected immunohistochemically in all cell types in gestational trophoblastic diseases and normal placenta. In situ hybridization for EGFR mRNA correlated with immunostaining for EGFR in all tissues studied. All 10 cases of choriocarcinoma exhibited strong immunoreactivity for EGFR. The levels of expression of EGFR in choriocarcinoma and syncytiotrophoblasts and cytotrophoblasts in complete mole were significantly greater than those in syncytiotrophoblasts and cytotrophoblasts in both normal placenta and partial mole (P < 0.01, P < 0.01). Expression of c-erbB-3 did not significantly differ among placental and gestational trophoblastic disease tissues and trophoblastic cell types except for significantly increased expression in choriocarcinoma as compared with cytotrophoblasts of partial mole (P = 0.02). The placenta, complete and partial mole, and choriocarcinoma tissues demonstrated similar immunoreactivity for c-erbB-4. Strong immunostaining for EGFR (P = 0.02) and c-erbB-3 (P < 0.01) in extravillous trophoblasts of complete mole was found to be significantly correlated with the development of persistent postmolar gestational trophoblastic tumor. CONCLUSION: The EGFR-related family of oncogenes may be important in the pathogenesis of gestational trophoblastic diseases. The increased expression of EGFR and c-erbB-3 in complete mole may also influence the development of persistent gestational trophoblastic tumor.
abstract_ja: 目的：妊娠性絨毛性疾患および正常胎盤におけるEGFR、c-erbB-3、c-erbB-4の発現を検討すること。研究デザイン：部分胞状奇胎16例、完全胞状奇胎25例、妊娠性絨毛癌10例、治療的中絶11例のパラフィン切片について、EGFR、c-erbB-3、c-erbB-4蛋白を免疫組織化学的に検討した。EGFR mRNAの存在はin situハイブリダイゼーションで検討した。結果：EGFRの染色は妊娠性絨毛性疾患および正常胎盤のすべての細胞型で検出された。EGFR mRNAのin situハイブリダイゼーションの結果は、検討したすべての組織で免疫染色と相関した。絨毛癌10例すべてがEGFRに強い免疫反応性を示した。完全胞状奇胎における絨毛癌ならびに合胞体栄養膜細胞および細胞栄養膜細胞のEGFR発現レベルは、正常胎盤および部分胞状奇胎の合胞体栄養膜細胞および細胞栄養膜細胞より有意に高かった（P<0.01、P<0.01）。c-erbB-3の発現は胎盤および妊娠性絨毛性疾患組織、ならびに栄養膜細胞の種類の間で有意差はなかったが、部分胞状奇胎の細胞栄養膜細胞と比べると絨毛癌で有意に増加していた（P=0.02）。胎盤、完全・部分胞状奇胎、絨毛癌組織はc-erbB-4に類似した免疫反応性を示した。完全胞状奇胎の絨毛外栄養膜細胞におけるEGFR（P=0.02）およびc-erbB-3（P<0.01）の強い染色は、持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発生と有意に相関していた。結論：EGFR関連癌遺伝子ファミリーは妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症に重要な役割を果たす可能性がある。完全胞状奇胎におけるEGFRおよびc-erbB-3の発現増加は、持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発生にも影響を与えうる。
